title: USA Advances to World Cup Round of 16 with Gritty 2-0 Win Over Bosnia and Herzegovina
text:
The United States men's national soccer team (USMNT) punched their ticket to the World Cup Round of 16 with a hard-fought 2-0 victory over Bosnia and Herzegovina in Santa Clara. Folarin Balogun's early goal and Malik Tillman's late strike secured the win, despite playing a man down for the final half-hour after Balogun's red card.
The United States secured a historic victory in the World Cup , defeating Bosnia and Herzegovina 2-0 in the last 32 at the San Francisco Bay Area Stadium.
Folarin Balogun opened the scoring in the 44th minute, sending the home crowd into a frenzy. However, the match took a chaotic turn in the 63rd minute when Balogun was sent off with a straight red card, leaving the Americans to defend a narrow lead down a man for the final half-hour. The USA defense dug deep, and Malik Tillman secured the victory in the 81st minute, sliding home a spectacular goal to seal the win.
Next up, a high-stakes Round of 16 clash against Belgium on July 6. The victory was celebrated across the country, with John Denver's 'Take Me Home, Country Roads' blaring out at the stadium. The USMNT's journey isn't over, and they look ahead to their clash with Belgium, despite Balogun's one-match ban for his red card
